comment: Source of truth for the two Web assessment checklists seeded at startup by DefaultWebChecklistSeeder. Item texts are taken verbatim, and in order, from the iSec Web penetration testing report template (sections 4.1 and 4.2 of iSec_WAPT_Template_Faction.docx). Faction records one result per question - PASS, FAIL or NA - plus a free-text comment, so the report's own wording maps onto it as: "Not Vulnerable"/"Passed" -> PASS, "Vulnerable" -> FAIL, "N/A" -> NA. No new result values are introduced. Question order is the array order below (zero-based), which is what the UI writes when a template is edited by hand. Fields other than name, preventClosure and questions are ignored by the seeder.

checklists.name: iSec Web Penetration Testing Checklist
checklists.description: Section 4.1 of the iSec Web penetration testing report: the attack types covered on every web engagement. Report status "Not Vulnerable" is PASS, "Vulnerable" is FAIL, "N/A" is NA.
questions: Presence of Debugging or Diagnostic Information
Improper Validation of File Upload Types

checklists.name: OWASP Web Top 10 (2025) Check List
checklists.description: Section 4.2 of the iSec Web penetration testing report: the OWASP Top 10 (2025) categories checked on every web engagement. Report status "Passed" is PASS, a category the application failed is FAIL, one that does not apply is NA.
questions: A08:2025 - Software or Data Integrity Failures
